artifacts.title: National academy young investigator medal
artifacts.description: Awarded each year to one researcher nationwide; the beneficiary received it in 2019 for work on protein-folding models, and two national newspapers reported the award.

artifacts.title: Feature profiles in a national science magazine
artifacts.description: A four-page 2024 profile of the beneficiary and their work on protein-folding models in a national magazine with a circulation of four hundred thousand, after shorter features in 2018 and 2021.

artifacts.title: Grant panel chair and editorial board service
artifacts.description: Chaired the national science agency's protein-folding models grant panel in 2021 and 2023, and has sat on the editorial board of the field's leading journal since 2017.

artifacts.title: Adoption record for the beneficiary's protein-folding models method
artifacts.description: The method has run in production at Institute for Molecular Simulation since 2018 and at four other organizations since; the 2015 founding paper has been cited over two thousand times.

artifacts.title: Compensation statements and national wage survey
artifacts.description: Base salary above the 99th percentile for computational biology in the national occupational wage survey in every year from 2020 to 2025.

artifacts.title: Peer review confirmations
artifacts.description: Confirmation emails for six manuscript reviews completed for two journals in computational biology.

artifacts.title: Five conference papers
artifacts.description: Five papers on protein-folding models in regional conference proceedings, cited thirty-eight times in total.

artifacts.title: Best paper award at a national computational biology conference
artifacts.description: Best paper award at a national computational biology conference, chosen from about four hundred submissions.
